item.title: Japanese artist Yayoi Kusama dies aged 97
item.description:

item.title: Two dead and 10 hurt after car rams into crowd in northern France
item.description:

item.title: Judge blocks Minnesota bid to extradite Texas ICE agent accused of shooting man
item.description:
A federal judge on Wednesday rejected Minnesota’s emergency attempt to force Texas to extradite an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent accused of shooting a Venezuelan man and lying about the incident, potentially clearing the way for the agent’s release from jail. Christian Castro, 52, faces four counts of second-degree assault and one count of falsely reporting a crime in Minnesota over a January shooting during an immigration enforcement operation in Minneapolis. The judge denied Minnesota’s request for a temporary restraining order that would have prevented the Cameron County sheriff from releasing Castro and required Texas Republican Gov. Greg Abbott to sign an extradition warrant allowing Minnesota authorities to take custody of him. Castro has been held in Texas since May. item.title: Tim Curry, the prolific performer who transformed for the screen – video
item.description:
Because this week evidently decided it hadn’t already taken enough beloved 80-year-olds from us , Tim Curry passed away Tuesday night. A king of camp, many remember Curry for scene-stealing roles in movies like Clue , The Rocky Horror Picture Show , and of course, Muppet Treasure Island . But he also loved popping up in video games, a perfect fit for his inimitably over-the-top stylings. According to Moby Games , Curry ultimately appeared in 22 games. While some of these were licensed fare—Curry voiced Nigel Thornberry in The Wild Thornberrys , after all—his gameography is littered with heavy hitters including Gabriel Knight , Wing Commander III: Heart of the Tiger , Brütal Legend , Dragon Age: Origins , and Command & Conquer: Red Alert 3 . The latter role pretty much guarantees Curry’s immortality all by itself thanks to a line read so good that Vice dedicated a whole oral history to…

item.title: Key moments from Lindsay Clancy's five-week trial over children's killings
item.description:
Over the course of nearly a month, Lindsay Clancy has stood trial for the January 2023 killings of her three young children, a catastrophic tragedy that has riveted the country. The scenes unfolding in Judge William Sullivan’s courtroom in Plymouth, Massachusetts, have been excruciating. “I can’t do this,” Clancy sobbed at one point, as testimony about the fatal injuries she inflicted on her children was delivered. Patrick, Clancy’s former husband, who has publicly forgiven her , took the stand amid viral conspiracy theories suggesting that he was the one who really killed their children. Then there were the family members, including Clancy’s mother and sister, who testified to Clancy’s declining mental health in the months before she killed her children, forcing them to relive the pain of a loved one struggling to get the help she begged for. item.title: Dolly Parton told us who she was, one song at a time
item.description:
My introduction to Dolly Parton came at 7. My mom, as the lead alto in the church choir, had some sway with our music director and she used it to snag me the occasional solo in front of the congregation. I sang hymns, some contemporary Christian songs. Then one day, Mom brought home the sheet music for “Coat of Many Colors.” The song wasn’t in the Baptist hymnal, but she seemed confident it would pass muster (after all, who doesn’t love Dolly?). I practiced at home, committing the lyrics to heart. I took my position on stage by the pulpit one Sunday, facing pews stuffed with people, and scanned the crowd for my mom as I started to sing. For the first time during one of my performances, she wept. My mom drew the parallels between Parton’s song and her own life — she, too, had grown up as an impoverished kid from a big family, and she’d learned a little bit about turning humble beginnings…

item.title: Brickbat: The Streets of San Francisco
item.description:
The competition for the much-coveted Who Won The Offseason Prize is nearly over. Despite a late rally from the Cleveland Browns, who became the first team to eliminate themselves from the regular season by quintupling down on the disaster that has been, is, and seems hell-bent on continuing to be Deshaun Watson , it seems clear that the winner will be the San Francisco 49ers. Besides, it's Reds Week , not Oranges Week, which means that even with that photo of Jed York in his jail smock, red is still the color of the day.
